install.notes: The gate and the fake backend need only Python 3.10+ and the standard library: fake.py is a package-local stand-in for the mujoco module and reads the MJCF text. The real sim backend needs the official mujoco module, and the upstream ROS 2 stack needs ROS 2 Humble, colcon and the dependencies declared by its packages. Neither the ROS stack nor MuJoCo was installed or run here.
